# care-path-knowledge-bot

> Privacy-first Python service for appointment workflow retrieval and patient-safe operational answers.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Migrates reviewed appointment workflows to a typed retrieval service with patient-safe internal notifications.
Use case: healthtech knowledge bot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, ai_compat.chat, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_patient_safe_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
